label: NATURAL GAMEPLAY EVIDENCE
note: Items observed in real PoE2 sessions, not generated by this project. Entries record what was seen and what the user judged; they are never produced from generator output and never edited to match it.

entries.label: NATURAL GAMEPLAY EVIDENCE
entries.reported_during: FILTER-09 (after the research closure at b0b2075)
entries.source: user observation in a real PoE2 session: a Utility Belt on the ground carried no label under the Build Intelligence aware Recommended filter

item.rarity: not recorded; Normal or Magic (a Rare is never hidden by the generic rules)
item.item_level: not recorded; the generic hide needs area level >= 65, the base needs item level >= 55

filter_context.note: the player's own build and filter were not captured; the reference build reproduces the same decision because the cause is build-independent

entries.observed: no label (hidden or de-emphasised by the generic low-rarity rules)

root_cause_classes: D rule ordering (a broad generic Hide in front of any opportunity)
not_causes: A data gap: the base is in the verified catalog
investigation.summary: Quality-only crafting rules (Quality >= 20) can never match a class that cannot carry quality (belts, rings, amulets, jewels, quivers); no jewellery crafting layer existed, so the belt reached HideLowQualityNormals.

final_policy.intent: show as a crafting substrate where the profile policy allows; not 'every belt'
final_policy.policy_reason_when_hidden: CRAFT_RELEVANT is a conditional substrate: Strict and Endgame keep it for Normal items only, Very Strict shows PREMIUM substrates only

profile_system_v2.source: approved profile matrix rows craft_relevant_normal / craft_relevant_magic (ItemLevel >= the base's breakpoint); QUIET = visible, no attention effects
